QUOTE: `_verdict` gives it only when `q.unsearched_corpora` returns nothing... Its docstring records four earlier cases (classes, variables, macros, typedefs/enums) where the strong wording was false, which is why the check exists.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes the current grading and past false "definitive" cases for unread corpora, but never says a single token matching nothing was previously treated as proof of absence, and it doesn't frame that as confusing "nothing exists" with "I did not look there". Its single-token discussion is about unread corpora, not the one-token-as-proof-of-absence mistake.
